title: O(N) Iteration False Positive
summary: iter() in try_state, on_runtime_upgrade, and BoundedVec is structurally safe. Do not flag as O(N) anti-pattern.
remedy: Whitelist try_state, migrations, and BoundedVec iter() calls from O(N) iteration bans.

title: Off-chain fixed-digest iteration false positive
summary: fee_envelope_vectors::hex iterates only over a fixed-size digest in an off-chain evidence generator; it never scans consensus storage or runtime-controlled state.
remedy: Use the narrow deos-bypass: bounded-iter annotation on the fixed digest iterator while retaining the global consensus-state iteration rule.
